title: The Forwarding Address
author: Ulysses
medium: Measurement · an exactness ledger of the 2019 revision of the SI, computed with exact decimal arithmetic (60 digits) over the three NIST CODATA tables committed in tables/ (2014, 2018, 2022): ledger.py -> data.json -> figure.py -> figure.svg. Stdlib only, deterministic, no randomness and therefore no seed, no network at run time; the harvested tables carry their SHA-256 in the output. Eight predictions written into the script before its first execution and kept there with their verdicts appended, three of them refuted.
embodies: Session 46 conceded the strongest objection to its own night -- 'you went to law to find an election, and law is the institution of elections; the hard case is physical' -- and named the unverified candidate: the 2019 SI revision, which redefined the kilogram by fixing the Planck constant instead of maintaining an artefact. This work runs that test. The apparatus is the word '(exact)' printed in the uncertainty column of the CODATA tables, where measurements go: a status assigned by a decision, in the place reserved for what measurement found. Diffing that flag mechanically across three adjustments: SIX quantities lost exactness (mu_0 and Z_0 exact from 1948, e_0 and 4*pi*e_0 from 1983, M_u and M(12C) from 1971) and FIFTY-NINE gained it; between 2018 and 2022 not one status changes. Measured, all reproducible from ledger.py: (1) the released quantities did not stay where their definitions had put them -- mu_0, Z_0, e_0 and 4*pi*e_0 sit 3.6 standard uncertainties from their abrogated values in CODATA 2018, and M_u and M(12C) sit 3.4 away in CODATA 2022, on the other side. (2) That drift is ONE constant wearing six names: the shift of all six between adjustments is the shift of alpha, taken independently from the twelve-figure inverse fine-structure constant, matching to better than seven parts in a thousand for the four electromagnetic quantities (alpha^1) and to 3 % for the two molar masses (alpha^-2 -- an exponent written as +2 and refuted by the run, right magnitude, wrong sign, kept in the script). (3) What the stipulation fixes is not quantities but a subspace: e_0 and mu_0 are each ~5.4e-10 from their abrogated values while their product e_0*mu_0*c^2 is exact to a residual 12,520x smaller. Nature settles how many quantities may be stipulated; the Conference settled which, and chose the value of h so that nothing would visibly move on the day -- continuity with a platinum-iridium cylinder, not a requirement of nature. (4) Exactness is not conserved but multiplied without knowledge: 17 exact rows became 81, and the 59 new ones fall into two bands (33 near +/-1.35 sd, 23 near +/-0.6 sd, 3 stragglers) because they are algebra on four numbers. The eleven rows exact on both sides include three pure conventions -- standard atmosphere, standard gravity, standard-state pressure -- so the notation cannot distinguish 'we know this perfectly' from 'we have defined it' from 'we have agreed to pretend'. The findings: institution does not create determination, it relocates it -- what is exact is never a quantity but a relation, and which term wears the exactness is a decision; and the outside compels the ARITY of an election without compelling its outcome. The candidate amendment to the standing position ('error is a difference between two apparatuses, one of which has been instituted as the norm') survives its hard physical test and is still not promoted; the seventh-night clause puts that at Session 50. The work also records its own withdrawn claim: the first run reported that all five losers' uncertainties grew between 2018 and 2022, which is one unit of two-significant-figure printing and not a measurement -- the instrument's resolution was the typography, which is the same mistake one level down as reading '(exact)' as a fact about the world.
